name: Planche Push-Up
steps: Place your hands shoulder-width apart with fingers turned slightly out and straighten your elbows.
Lean your shoulders forward until both feet lift and your body balances in a horizontal line.
Bend your elbows smoothly backward close to your ribs to lower your chest toward the floor without letting your feet touch down.
Press powerfully through your palms to extend your arms straight back into the locked horizontal planche.
tips: Maintain strong forward shoulder projection as you bend your elbows so your feet do not drop.
Keep your abs and glutes clenched tightly to preserve a flat horizontal body line.
